spec.intent:
Census @a9258730; re-derive any line cited below if its path changed since (units-in-worktrees lands first and edits the plan and deliver skills). Realize the clause `prime principle` gained at 2026-09-30T10:05 (operator ruling 'cold-decode oracle scope'): the cold-decode oracle decides signs only for the corpus's core agent dimension names and values, the terminology it was built to discover; every other term is the industry's own, used as the industry understands it, and nothing cratylus ships holds a consumer's own surfaces to the oracle.
AT CENSUS shipped laws hold every surface to the oracle's sign. The cratylism value's `∀ authored-surface ⟨σ* ∨ ⊕σ* · prose ≡ identifier ≡ path⟩` (packages/canon/src/dimensions/engineering-principles/cratylism.ts:3) reaches the ten skills carrying the prime principle (packages/canon/src/genus/prime-principle.ts) and every agent holding the architect, planner, implementer or assayer role, so an agent working in a consumer's repository holds that repository's names to σ*. signify defines `Art ≜ every authored surface` and `dom(α) spans EVERY altitude of Art` (packages/canon/src/skills/signify/skill.ts:37-38; its description says the same). design routes each concept's anchor through signify (packages/canon/src/skills/design/skill.ts:21, 31-32, `∀ c : conform(anchor(c))` at :54, and the pipeline at :90), so a consumer's own design concepts must be cold-decoded. formalize demands `∀ line ∈ B : line = σ*(its concept)` and `σ*(c) ∉ T ⇒ extend T with σ*(c) ⟨cold-verify⟩` (packages/canon/src/skills/formalize/skill.ts:22, 32), and create-skill's green declares 'the fittest glyph + cold-verify' (packages/canon/src/skills/create-skill/skill.ts:19). cold-decode-oracle, held by nico, states `invariant ∀f` (packages/canon/src/dimensions/engineering-principles/cold-decode-oracle.ts:3).
CHANGE. Scope each of these laws to the corpus's core agent dimension names and values, and say once, in the cratylism value, that every other term is the industry's own, used as the industry understands it, and that no consumer surface is held to the oracle. A design concept's anchor and a formal block's notation answer to no cold decode. Keep the axiom's opening `cratylism ⟨names natural` (test/cratylism.test.ts pins one home for it). Keep `conform` defined in signify: the plan and deliver skills cite `conform @ signify`, which is register, not a sign decision. The cratylism value is part of the plan skill's projected preamble, so plan must stay under Claude's hook cap (test/skill-hook-cap.test.ts). State the scope in packages/canon/README.md's first-principle paragraph (L53-58) and in genus/prime-principle.ts's doc comment. If a divergence the altitude ledger records stops diverging, delete its row in test/symbol-altitude.test.ts. The hand-authored ground documents (VISION.md, MODEL.md, ENGINE.md, CANON.md) are not this unit's. Add .changeset/oracle-scope.md (@cratylus/canon patch).
